distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 285.9949 +/- 0.0599 mas (same row, RUWE 1.20): 3.50 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.6611 +/- 0.0048 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 820A: mass 0.68 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
